failures.rule: brand/constitution.md E1, E2 and Article 4 C2; product/ui-constitution.md Article 7 (attention on purpose)
failures.place: Dense white arcs across the You keep label and $31.40.
failures.issue: The high-contrast repeated lines run directly through both text areas and become a competing foreground pattern. The field asks for attention independently of the money it is meant to support; the amount remains readable, but the texture fails the calm, subordinate role.

across_options.issue: The jacket photograph is not held fixed: fold details, collar shape, highlights and the floor change between renders. This is unrelated to D5 and weakens a controlled comparison of the field.

In opt-base.png, Listed at, Offered and Ship by Tuesday begin around x=210. In the other four images they begin around x=179. The price values and action row stay approximately fixed. This changes alignment independently of D5.

The payout text moves from approximately x=221 in the base to x=194 in both placement variants; the amount also varies slightly in width. Field placement is therefore accompanied by changed text inset and typography geometry.

Whole moment also makes the gradient substantially paler and fades it toward white. The comparison changes color strength as well as coverage. Its greater-than-one-third coverage is the explicit ledger D5 proposal, so it is not counted as a failure of the existing ceiling.

Strong lines changes the gradient itself toward brighter cyan and more saturated yellow-green, in addition to changing line density and contrast. Medium lines also shifts the curve placement. The texture comparison does not hold the underlying color field fixed.
